_doc: Copy-fee vectors (plan step 2.F; program `schedina::math::copy_fee` / `copy_split`). Integer micro-units. open_pending of a copy (copied_from set) escrows escrow_u = stake_u + copy_fee_u with copy_fee_u = ceil(stake_u * copy_fee_bps / 10_000) (charged to the user: rounds up, C1). finalize at fill ratio r_ppm: rs_u = floor(stake_u * r_ppm / 1e6) (C2); copy_used_u = floor(copy_fee_u * r_ppm / 1e6) (same scaling as rs_u); tipster_u = floor(copy_used_u * tipster_share_bps / 10_000) goes to the tipster's USDC account (TipsterPaid.amount_u); house_u = copy_used_u - tipster_u is credited to Vault.free; refund_u = (stake_u - rs_u) + (copy_fee_u - copy_used_u) goes back to the user (TicketMinted.refund_u, Ticket.refund_u); Ticket.copy_fee_u = copy_used_u. refund_pending returns escrow_u. Own tickets and own tips carry no copy fee. copy_fee_bps and tipster_share_bps are read from Config at open_pending and finalize respectively. programs/schedina/tests/copy_fee_vectors.rs checks the program's math against this file.

copy_fee.name: 5 USDC minimum demo stake, full fill
1 USDC + 1 micro, fee rounds up, r = 1/3
